extracted.intended_audience: EPO examiners, patent attorneys, applicants, and other practitioners interacting with European patent prosecution and opposition
extracted.subtask_description: Official European Patent Office Guidelines covering procedural, formal and substantive standards for filing, searching, examining, opposing, amending and maintaining European patent applications and patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preliminary remarks
rubrics_metrics.description: Introductory observations and scope-setting for the Guidelines for Examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explanatory notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Notes explaining how the Guidelines should be read, interpreted or applied.

rubrics_metrics.name: General remarks
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level principles and general considerations applicable across examination and proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work at the EPO
rubrics_metrics.description: Organisational and practical matters concerning how examination work is conducted at the EPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary of the processing of applications and patents at the EPO
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of the lifecycle and procedures for processing applications and patents before the EPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contracting States
rubrics_metrics.description: Information and requirements related to states party to the European Patent Convention (EPC).

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension to and validation in states not party to the EPC
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive considerations for extension/validation of European patents in non‑EPC states.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of applications and examination on filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and checks at filing and initial formal examination of a European patent application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of formal requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for assessing whether an application meets the formal requirements under the EPC and EPO practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Special procedural or substantive provisions that apply in particular circumstances or application types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications concerning formal deficiencies; amendment of application; correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: How formal deficiencies are communicated, how applicants may amend applications, and procedures for correcting errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of application; request for examination and transmission of the dossier to examining division
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and timing for publication, requesting substantive examination, and transmission of the file to the examining division.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Language requirements and consequences for proceedings and documents filed at the EPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Common provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions that commonly apply across multiple formalities topics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for drawings submitted with a European patent application (form, content and formalities).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules concerning fees due to the EPO (payment, calculation, consequences of non‑payment).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection of files; communication of information contained in files; consultation of the European Patent Register; issuance of certified copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for public or party inspection of file contents, register consultation and certified copies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characteristics of the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles and quality characteristics that should define the EPO search (scope, completeness, relevance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search procedure and strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommended procedures and strategies examiners should follow when conducting prior‑art searches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preclassification, IPC and CPC classification of European patent applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on classification of documents/applications using IPC/CPC and preclassification practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: The state of the art at the search stage
rubrics_metrics.description: How to determine and characterise the state of the art when performing the search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria for assessing whether an application complies with the requirement of unity of invention (appears in search and substantive examination contexts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Referenced in both search (Part B) and application content (Part F); applies to determination of single general inventive concept or groups of inventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject‑matter to be excluded from the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Types of subject‑matter or content that should not be included in the EPO search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for documentation of search results and how search documentation should be prepared and recorded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search report
rubrics_metrics.description: Content, form and quality standards for the European search report.

rubrics_metrics.name: The search opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on preparing the search opinion that accompanies the search report, including evaluations and indications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal requirements to be met before the division starts substantive examination
rubrics_metrics.description: List and standards of formal requirements which must be satisfied before substantive examination begins.

rubrics_metrics.name: The first stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and criteria applied in the initial substantive examination stage by the examining division.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of replies and further stages of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for evaluating applicants' replies and conducting subsequent examination stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: The final stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedures applicable at the conclusion of substantive examination leading to grant or refusal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard marks for indicating amendments or corrections by the divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Conventions for marking amendments or corrections made by examining or opposition divisions on documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits and acceleration of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing procedural time limits, requests for accelerated processing and their effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other procedures in examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional procedural matters that can arise during substantive examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work within the examining division
rubrics_metrics.description: Organisation of work, responsibilities and internal procedures within examining divisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive rules applicable to special types of applications (e.g., patent term extension requests, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: The opposition division
rubrics_metrics.description: Role, composition and procedures of the opposition division in post‑grant proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive standards governing opposition to a granted European patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure up to substantive examination (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Steps and requirements for opposition proceedings prior to substantive examination of grounds.

rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and approach to substantive assessment of oppositions (novelty, inventive step, sufficiency, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for the examination of the opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural sequence and requirements for conducting opposition examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Details and special features of the proceedings (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Particular procedural details and exceptional features that may occur in opposition proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions of the opposition division
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for drafting, issuing and reasoning in opposition division decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and considerations relating to costs in opposition and other proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation and revocation procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive rules for limiting or revoking a European patent post‑grant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications and notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for formal communications and notifications between the EPO, applicants and third parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures governing oral proceedings before EPO bodies (examining divisions, opposition division, Boards).

rubrics_metrics.name: Taking and conservation of evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for admitting, evaluating and preserving evidence in proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derogations from the language of the proceedings in oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and rules permitting derogations from the official language during oral proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination by the EPO of its own motion; facts, evidence or grounds not submitted in due time; observations by third parties
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on EPO‑initiated examination, late submissions, and third‑party observations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interruption, stay and consolidation of the proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedures for interrupting, staying or consolidating proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits, loss of rights, further and accelerated processing and reestablishment of rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and substantive consequences relating to time limits, loss and restoration of rights and acceleration options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)
rubrics_metrics.description: How PCT applications are handled before the EPO and related procedural requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: General guidance on formulation, issuance and content of EPO decisions across procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impartiality of the examining or opposition division
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and safeguards to ensure impartiality of decision‑making bodies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural and substantive framework governing appeals against EPO decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request from a national court for a technical opinion concerning a European patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for providing technical opinions to national courts upon request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registration of changes of name, transfers, licences and other rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for registering assignments, transfers, licences and other rights affecting a European patent/application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content of a European patent application (other than claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for the description, abstract and other parts of the application besides claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Checklist for considering the abstract (see F‑II, 2.5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Checklist and criteria for preparing and evaluating the abstract of a European patent application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Units recognised in international practice and complying with Rule 49(10)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on acceptable units of measurement consistent with international practice and EPC Rule 49(10).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sufficiency of disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for determining whether the disclosure in the application is sufficiently clear and complete for the skilled person to carry out the invention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims (Art. 84 and formal requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal and clarity requirements for claims under Article 84 and related EPO practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples concerning essential features
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrative examples to help determine essential features of claimed inventions for formal and substantive assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and standards for claiming and assessing priority rights under the Paris Convention and the EPC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentability
rubrics_metrics.description: Overall criteria and standards that determine whether subject‑matter is patentable under the EPC framework.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and boundary criteria of what constitutes an invention for patentability purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial application
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and standards for establishing industrial applicability of the claimed invention.

rubrics_metrics.name: State of the art
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and treatment of the prior art relevant to novelty and inventive step assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non‑prejudicial disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances under which disclosures do not prejudice novelty or inventive step (e.g., grace periods, emergency disclosures).

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria for assessing novelty of claimed subject‑matter over the state of the art.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive Step
rubrics_metrics.description: Approach and criteria for assessing inventive step (non‑obviousness) of claims, including indicators and examples.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annex contains examples relating to the requirement of inventive step – indicators.

rubrics_metrics.name: The right to amend
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles governing the applicant's or patentee's right to amend the application or patent during proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments – general rules
rubrics_metrics.description: General standards for when amendments to an application or patent are admissible procedurally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments – other procedural matters
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional procedural considerations affecting the admissibility of amendments.

rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive tests for whether amendments add subject‑matter (Art. 123(2)) or extend protection (Art. 123(3)).

rubrics_metrics.description: Concrete examples illustrating permissible and impermissible amendments under the allowability tests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for correcting errors in applications or granted patents (formal and substantive corrections).

rubrics_metrics.name: Index for Computer‑Implemented Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Indexed guidance specific to examination of computer‑implemented inventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alphabetical Keyword Index
rubrics_metrics.description: Alphabetical index of topics for locating guidance across the Guidelines.
